summary: P1 (Customizable Proposal Item Types) and P2 (Credit Warnings) features tested successfully. All backend tests passed (10/10). Frontend UI verified working correctly. Business Clarity page loads correctly after refactor.

P1_proposal_item_types_settings.details: Settings > Templates tab > 'Proposal Item Types' section displays 4 default types (Food, Service, Rental, Fee) with EN/ES labels, color pickers, active toggles, and 'Add Type' button. Save Item Types button works correctly.

P1_proposal_item_types_api.details: GET /api/settings/company returns proposal_item_types array with all required fields (type_key, label_en, label_es, color, icon, is_active). PUT /api/settings/company successfully updates item type labels.

P1_proposal_editor_uses_custom_labels.details: ProposalEditor displays item types using translated labels from company settings: 'Food & Beverages', 'Services & Staff', 'Rentals & Equipment', 'Fees & Charges'.

P2_credit_warnings_api.details: GET /api/proposals/event/{event_id} returns credit_warnings array and client_credit object when client has credit enabled. Warnings generated correctly when proposal exceeds credit limit.

P2_credit_warnings_ui.details: ProposalEditor displays red warning banner when client is over credit limit. Shows message 'This proposal would exceed client credit limit by $X', available credit info, and percentage used.

P2_credit_context_badge.details: Credit context info displayed in warning banner showing available/used amounts and percentage.

business_clarity_dashboard.details: Business Clarity page loads correctly after refactor. Dashboard shows Receivables, Overdue, Payables, Net Flow metrics, Profit Signals, Aging Analysis, and Recent Payments.

business_clarity_fixed_costs.details: Fixed Costs & Budget tab loads correctly. Shows Budget vs Actual by Category with variance analysis.

business_clarity_reports.details: Executive Reports tab loads correctly. Shows Operational Profit (Accrued) and Cash Position (Realized) with CSV/PDF export options.

critical_code_review_comments: Frontend warning in ProposalEditor.js: React Hook useEffect has missing dependencies - consider adding fetchClient, fetchEventInvoices, etc. to dependency array or using useCallback
Frontend warning: jspdf and jspdf-autotable modules not found in business-clarity components - PDF export may not work
